title: Happy Corn
tagline: A user-friendly Ecommerce Marketplace for Digital Products. Seamlessly integrated with NFT minting capabilities, our platform empowers digital artists, content creators, and collectors to buy, sell, and mint customized digital products as NFTs with ease.
description: Happy Corn is an innovative e-commerce platform designed to revolutionize the way digital products are bought and sold. Leveraging the power of blockchain technology and cryptocurrency, Happy Corn provides a secure and efficient marketplace for users to browse, purchase, and sell a wide range of digital downloads.
how_its_made:
Blockchain Integration: Happy Corn leverages blockchain technology, specifically Ethereum, for its underlying infrastructure. Smart contracts written in Solidity are deployed on the Ethereum blockchain to manage transactions, product listings, and escrow services.

Cryptocurrency Payments: To enable cryptocurrency payments in Ethereum, Happy Corn integrates with various blockchain wallets and payment gateways, including MetaMask. These integrations allow users to seamlessly pay for digital products using their preferred cryptocurrencies.

IPFS for File Storage: Happy Corn utilizes the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) to securely store digital product files. Sellers upload their product files to IPFS, and the resulting IPFS hash is stored on the Ethereum blockchain as a reference point for the product.

Frontend Development: The frontend of Happy Corn is built using modern web development technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript,Next.js and Ethers.js. This ensures a responsive and intuitive user interface for buyers and sellers to interact with the platform.


Smart Contract Development: Smart contracts are written in Solidity, Ethereum's native programming language, to implement the core logic of Happy Corn's features, including product listings, transactions, escrow management, and dispute resolution.

Deployment: The smart contract is deployed in Arbitrum Sepolia Testnet.
